Across official RBI / CCIL NDS-OM on-the-run Government of India Dated Securities (G-Sec), the 3Y benchmark (6.20% GS 2029 (RBI)) yields 6.958%, 5Y benchmark (6.53% GS 2031 (RBI)) trades at 7.023%, 10Y benchmark (6.94% GS 2036 (RBI)) yields 7.162% (+228 bps over 10Y UST), and 30Y benchmark (7.63% GS 2056 (RBI)) closes at 7.619%. Per RBI's Weekly Statistical Supplement, India's Foreign Exchange Reserves stand at US$717.06B, anchoring spot USD/INR at ₹93.8950 (FBIL Reference Rate ₹94.1402).

macroPillars.heading: RBI / CCIL Sovereign G-Sec Curve & Friday ₹36,000 Cr Primary Auction (rbi.org.in · 06 Nov 2026)
macroPillars.analysis: Official RBI/CCIL G-Sec benchmarks remain well-bid across the curve: 1Y at 6.451%, 2Y at 6.871%, 3Y (6.20% GS 2029 (RBI)) at 6.958%, 5Y (6.53% GS 2031 (RBI)) at 7.023%, 10Y (6.94% GS 2036 (RBI)) at 7.162%, 15Y (7.06% GS 2041 (RBI)) at 7.343%, and 30Y (7.63% GS 2056 (RBI)) at 7.619%. 06 Nov 2026 (PR #63936): 7.06% GS 2041 (₹23,000 Cr) cut-off at ₹97.07 / 7.3881%; 7.43% GS 2076 (₹13,000 Cr) cut-off at ₹95.70 / 7.7708% · PD Devolvement: NIL.

macroPillars.heading: RBI LAF Corridor (Repo 5.50% / SDF 5.25% / MSF 5.75%), VRR/VRRR & T-Bill Cut-Offs
macroPillars.analysis: RBI actively manages banking system liquidity via fine-tuning Variable Rate Repo (4-day VRR) and Variable Rate Reverse Repo (3-day VRRR) operations, keeping interbank Call Money within 4.30% - 5.75%. Meanwhile, 91-Day, 182-Day, and 364-Day Treasury Bills yield 5.897%, 6.320%, and 6.649% ahead of RBI's ₹23,000 Cr weekly T-Bill tender.

macroPillars.heading: Indian Rupee (FBIL Reference ₹94.1402), US$717.06B FX Reserves & Nifty 50 / Sensex
macroPillars.analysis: Onshore USD/INR spot trades at ₹93.8950 (-0.60%) alongside the official RBI/FBIL Reference Rate at ₹94.1402, backed by US$717.06B in total RBI Forex Reserves. In equities, Nifty 50 stands at 24,986.40 (-0.18%) and S&P BSE Sensex at 80,999.40 (-0.04%).

commentary.policyPosture: Neutral Calibration (RBI Repo 5.50% · SDF 5.25% · MSF 5.75% · CRR 3.00%)

argonCommentary.title: GEMINI 4 ARGON · INDIA SOVEREIGN (RBI / CCIL G-SEC), LAF & INR SYNTHESIS
argonCommentary.conviction: Long 5Y–10Y FAR G-Secs (6.53% GS 2031 / 6.94% GS 2036) · Positive Carry +228 bps vs UST · Watch RBI VRR/VRRR
argonCommentary.synthesis: Reserve Bank of India (RBI · rbi.org.in) and CCIL/NDS-OM sovereign fixings (06 Nov 2026) place the 3Y G-Sec benchmark (6.20% GS 2029) at 6.958%, 5Y benchmark (6.53% GS 2031) at 7.023%, 10Y benchmark (6.94% GS 2036) at 7.162%, and 30Y G-Sec (7.63% GS 2056) at 7.619% (5s10s slope at +14 bps; +228 bps over 10Y US Treasuries). With the RBI Monetary Policy Committee maintaining the Policy Repo Rate at 5.50% (SDF floor at 5.25%, MSF ceiling at 5.75%, CRR at 3.00%) and 91D/364D T-Bills clearing at 5.897%/6.649%, RBI's US$717.06B Foreign Exchange Reserves cushion spot USD/INR around ₹93.8950 (FBIL Reference Rate ₹94.1402) as Nifty 50 trades at 24,986.40 (-0.18%). Lead India macro catalyst: "Stock markets on fire; Sensex jumps 1,718 points, Nifty reclaims 25,000".
argonCommentary.positioningTakeaway: Overweight Fully Accessible Route (FAR) 5Y–10Y Indian G-Secs (7.023%–7.162%) to capture +228 bps sovereign spread over USTs and low FX volatility backed by RBI's US$717.06B reserve war chest; monitor RBI fine-tuning VRR/VRRR LAF operations keeping overnight call rates (4.30% - 5.75%) aligned with the 5.50% Repo anchor.

criticalLevels.implication: Yields near 7.30% attract PSU bank SLR & foreign FAR inflows; sub-7.04% requires softer food CPI.
Active RBI VRR/VRRR liquidity auctions prevent overnight call/TREPS rates from breaching the 5.25%–5.75% LAF band.
RBI two-way FX intervention backed by US$717.1B reserves caps rupee volatility near ₹94.55.
Domestic SIP inflows and banking earnings offset foreign equity rotation and support INR capital account stability.
